hadi-march/ui#ColorInput.name: ColorInput
hadi-march/ui#ColorInput.doc: Color: native swatch picker plus a #RRGGBB text field.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#ColorInput.tr: Renk: yerel örnek seçici ve #RRGGBB metin alanı.

hadi-march/ui#ColorPicker.name: ColorPicker
hadi-march/ui#ColorPicker.doc: Color picker: `<ColorPicker bind:value={$c} />`. The value is a CSS color string in the chosen format.

props.name: alpha
props.doc: Alpha slider and alpha in the value (default true).

props.name: format
props.doc: Text format of the value (default "hex"); the switcher changes it.

props.name: palettes
props.doc: Palettes under the picker. Default: HADİ colors, the theme palette and recent picks.

props.name: recent
props.doc: Recent picks kept (default 8; 0 hides them).

props.name: eyedropper
props.doc: Eyedropper button where the browser has one (default true).

props.name: contrast
props.doc: Contrast against white and black (default true).

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#ColorPicker.tr: Renk seçici: `<ColorPicker bind:value={$c} />`. Değer, seçilen biçimde bir CSS renk dizesidir.

hadi-march/ui#Combobox.name: Combobox
hadi-march/ui#Combobox.doc: Props: options (static) or search(q) → Promise<options>; debounce (ms, 250); minChars (0 static / 1 async); limit (50); placeholder; renderOption(o); labelOf(value) (label for a value not in options); allowCustom (typed text becomes the value); multiple (array value, chips); onSelect(option). Options: [value] or [{ value, label, hint, disabled }].

props.name: options
props.doc: Static options: [value] or [{ value, label, hint, disabled }].

props.name: search
props.type: ((q: string) => Promise<readonly unknown[]> | readonly unknown[]) | undefined
props.doc: Async options for the typed text.

props.name: minChars
props.doc: Characters before searching (0 static / 1 async).

props.name: labelOf
props.doc: Label for a value that is not in the options.

props.name: allowCustom
props.doc: Typed text becomes the value.

props.name: multiple
props.doc: Array value, chips.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#Combobox.tr: Arama kutulu seçim: statik options ya da eşzamansız search(q); gecikme, en az karakter, sınır ve özel değer seçenekleriyle.

hadi-march/ui#CommandPalette.name: CommandPalette
hadi-march/ui#CommandPalette.doc: `<CommandPalette ask={(q) => api.intent(q)} placeholder="…" shortcut="mod+k" limit={50} commands={[…]} />` ask(query) → Promise<{ results: [{ id, reason }] }> (ids of commands/pages/actions). The dialog itself loads on first open.

props.name: ask
props.type: (query: string) => Promise<{ results?: readonly AskResult[] | null } | null | undefined>
props.doc: Optional intent search: resolves ids of commands/pages/actions (or hrefs) with a reason.

props.name: askDelay
props.doc: ms before `ask` runs by itself when local results are weak (default 600).

props.name: shortcut
props.doc: Toggle shortcut (default "mod+k"); false = none.

props.name: limit
props.doc: Maximum local results (default 50).

props.name: commands
props.doc: Extra commands for this palette only.

hadi-march/ui#CommandPalette.tr: `<CommandPalette ask={(q) => api.intent(q)} placeholder="…" shortcut="mod+k" limit={50} commands={[…]} />` ask(query) → Promise<{ results: [{ id, reason }] }> (komut/sayfa/eylem kimlikleri). Diyalogun kendisi tembel yüklenir.

hadi-march/ui#confirm.name: confirm
hadi-march/ui#confirm.doc: Ask a yes/no question. Resolves true (ok) or false (cancel, Escape, overlay).
hadi-march/ui#confirm.tr: Evet/hayır sorusu sorar. true (tamam) veya false (iptal, Escape, kaplama) ile sonuçlanır.

hadi-march/ui#contrastOf.name: contrastOf
hadi-march/ui#contrastOf.doc: WCAG contrast ratio of two colors (1–21; alpha ignored), with the theme's contrast helper.
hadi-march/ui#contrastOf.signature: function contrastOf(a: Rgba, b: Rgba): number
hadi-march/ui#contrastOf.tr: İki rengin WCAG karşıtlık oranı (1–21; alfa yok sayılır), temanın karşıtlık yardımcısıyla.

hadi-march/ui#convert.name: convert
hadi-march/ui#convert.doc: Convert a value to another type, keeping what can be kept.
hadi-march/ui#convert.signature: function convert(v: unknown, to: Exclude<JsonType, "integer">): unknown
hadi-march/ui#convert.tr: Bir değeri başka türe çevirir, korunabilecekleri korur.

hadi-march/ui#CopyButton.name: CopyButton
hadi-march/ui#CopyButton.doc: Copy text to the clipboard: `<CopyButton text={() => token} label="Copy" />`
hadi-march/ui#CopyButton.tr: Metni panoya kopyalar: `<CopyButton text={() => token} label="Copy" />`

hadi-march/ui#CountRoll.name: CountRoll

props.name: format
props.doc: compact: 1,2 B · full: 1.234 (grouped). Default compact.

props.name: hideZero
props.doc: Hide at 0 (an empty count next to an icon).

props.name: duration
props.doc: Roll duration (ms). Default 320.

hadi-march/ui#CountRoll.tr: `<CountRoll value={$likes} />` — sayı değişimini yuvarlanma animasyonuyla gösterir.

hadi-march/ui#coverScale.name: coverScale
hadi-march/ui#coverScale.doc: Scale (screen px per image px) at zoom 1: the rotated image just covers a fw × fh frame.
hadi-march/ui#coverScale.signature: function coverScale(iw: number, ih: number, fw: number, fh: number, deg: number): number
hadi-march/ui#coverScale.tr: Zoom 1'de ölçek (görsel pikseli başına ekran pikseli): döndürülmüş görsel fw × fh çerçevesini tam kaplar.

hadi-march/ui#cropToCanvas.name: cropToCanvas
hadi-march/ui#cropToCanvas.doc: Draw the cropped image on a canvas. `width` is the output width (default: the image's own resolution across the frame); the height follows the frame's aspect.
hadi-march/ui#cropToCanvas.signature: function cropToCanvas(img: CanvasImageSource & { naturalWidth?: number; naturalHeight?: number; width?: number | SVGAnimatedLength; height?: number | SVGAnimatedLength }, st: CropState, view: { width: number; height: number }, opts: { width?: number; canvas?: HTMLCanvasElement } = {}): HTMLCanvasElement

params.name: img
params.type: CanvasImageSource & { naturalWidth?: number; naturalHeight?: number; width?: number | SVGAnimatedLength; height?: number | SVGAnimatedLength }

hadi-march/ui#cropToCanvas.tr: Kırpılmış görseli bir canvas'a çizer. `width` çıktı genişliğidir (varsayılan: görselin çerçeve boyunca kendi çözünürlüğü); yükseklik çerçevenin en-boy oranını izler.

hadi-march/ui#currencyInfo.name: currencyInfo
hadi-march/ui#currencyInfo.doc: Currency symbol, its side and the currency's minor digits for a locale.
hadi-march/ui#currencyInfo.signature: function currencyInfo(loc: string | undefined, currency: string): { symbol: string; prefix: boolean; digits: number }

returns.type: { symbol: string; prefix: boolean; digits: number }

hadi-march/ui#currencyInfo.tr: Bir dil için para birimi simgesi, tarafı ve para biriminin küçük birim basamakları.

hadi-march/ui#DatePicker.name: DatePicker
hadi-march/ui#DatePicker.doc: Date input with a calendar popover. Value: ISO date string or null. Props: min, max, firstDay, locale, placeholder.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#DatePicker.tr: Takvim açılır penceresi olan tarih girişi. Değer: ISO tarih dizesi veya null. Proplar: min, max, firstDay, locale, placeholder.

hadi-march/ui#DateRangePicker.name: DateRangePicker
hadi-march/ui#DateRangePicker.doc: Date range { from, to } with presets (today, 7/30/90 days, this month) and a custom from/to pair. Props: presets (array like rangePresets() or false), today, min, max.

props.name: presets
props.doc: Presets (like rangePresets()) or false for only the custom from / to pair.

props.name: today
props.doc: "Today" for the built-in presets.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#DateRangePicker.tr: Hazır ayarlı (bugün, 7/30/90 gün, bu ay) ve özel başlangıç/bitiş çiftli { from, to } tarih aralığı. Proplar: presets (rangePresets() gibi dizi veya false), today, min, max.

hadi-march/ui#DateTimeInput.name: DateTimeInput
hadi-march/ui#DateTimeInput.doc: Date + time; value is an ISO timestamp (UTC, like `new Date().toISOString()`), edited in local time.

props.name: defaultTime
props.doc: Time used when only a date is picked ("00:00").

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#DateTimeInput.tr: Tarih + saat; değer bir ISO zaman damgasıdır (UTC, `new Date().toISOString()` gibi), yerel saatte düzenlenir.

hadi-march/ui#dayLabel.name: dayLabel
hadi-march/ui#dayLabel.signature: function dayLabel(v: Date | string | number, now: Date = new Date()): string

hadi-march/ui#deepEqual.name: deepEqual
hadi-march/ui#deepEqual.doc: Structural equality for edited values: plain objects and arrays by content; null, undefined and "" are equal.
hadi-march/ui#deepEqual.signature: function deepEqual(a: unknown, b: unknown): boolean
hadi-march/ui#deepEqual.tr: Düzenlenen değerler için yapısal eşitlik: düz nesneler ve diziler içeriğe göre; null, undefined ve "" eşittir.

hadi-march/ui#DEFAULT_CROP.name: DEFAULT_CROP
hadi-march/ui#DEFAULT_CROP.doc: Starting crop: the whole image, no rotation or flip.
hadi-march/ui#DEFAULT_CROP.value: { zoom: 1, rotate: 0, flip: false, x: 0, y: 0, aspect: null, w: 0.84, h: 0.84 }
hadi-march/ui#DEFAULT_CROP.tr: Başlangıç kırpması: görselin tamamı, döndürme veya çevirme yok.

hadi-march/ui#DEFAULT_TOOLS.name: DEFAULT_TOOLS
hadi-march/ui#DEFAULT_TOOLS.doc: Toolbar buttons RichTextEditor shows when `tools` is not given, in order.
hadi-march/ui#DEFAULT_TOOLS.tr: `tools` verilmediğinde RichTextEditor'ın sırayla gösterdiği araç çubuğu düğmeleri.

hadi-march/ui#defineMeta.name: defineMeta
hadi-march/ui#defineMeta.doc: Typed helper for a component folder's meta.ts (name, status, category, composedOf …).
hadi-march/ui#defineMeta.tr: Bir bileşen klasörünün meta.ts dosyası için tipli yardımcı (name, status, category, composedOf …).

hadi-march/ui#definePlayground.name: definePlayground
hadi-march/ui#definePlayground.doc: Typed helper for a component folder's playground.ts (the showcase options).
hadi-march/ui#definePlayground.tr: Bir bileşen klasörünün playground.ts dosyası (vitrin seçenekleri) için tipli yardımcı.

hadi-march/ui#Dialog.name: Dialog
hadi-march/ui#Dialog.doc: Declarative dialog: `<Dialog open={$open} onClose={() => $open = false} title="…" size="md" footer={…}>…</Dialog>`
hadi-march/ui#Dialog.tr: Bildirimsel diyalog: `<Dialog open={$open} onClose={() => $open = false} title="…" size="md" footer={…}>…</Dialog>`

hadi-march/ui#Disclosure.name: Disclosure
hadi-march/ui#Disclosure.doc: A native <details> section with an animated open/close and a summary line.
hadi-march/ui#Disclosure.tr: Animasyonlu açılıp kapanan ve özet satırı olan yerel bir <details> bölümü.

hadi-march/ui#distance.name: distance
hadi-march/ui#distance.doc: Damerau-Levenshtein (optimal string alignment) distance; stops early above `max`.
hadi-march/ui#distance.signature: function distance(a: string, b: string, max: number = Infinity): number
hadi-march/ui#distance.tr: Damerau-Levenshtein (optimal string alignment) uzaklığı; `max` aşılınca erken durur.

hadi-march/ui#Divider.name: Divider
hadi-march/ui#Divider.tr: `<Divider />` veya `<Divider label="or" />`; satır içi ayırıcılar için `vertical`.

props.name: layout
props.doc: Initial layout: `["a", "b"]` one group, `{ row: [["files"], { column: [["editor"], ["console"]], share: .7 }], share: .25 }`. Default: every panel in one group.

props.name: persist
props.doc: Save the layout under this key (and load it on start).

props.name: storage
props.doc: Where to save it (default localStorage). `storage().local` from the Storage manager works.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the workspace.

props.name: commands
props.doc: Command id prefix for the palette (default "dock"); false: register no commands.

props.name: onClose
props.doc: Return false to keep the panel (e.g. after asking about unsaved changes).

hadi-march/ui#Drawer.name: Drawer
hadi-march/ui#Drawer.doc: `<Drawer open={$open} onClose={() => $open = false} side="bottom" snapPoints={[0.4, 0.9]} title="…">…</Drawer>` Closing animates out before the panel leaves the document.

props.name: side
props.doc: Edge (read when it opens). Default "end".

props.name: size
props.doc: Width (start / end) or height (top / bottom): sm, md, lg, full. Ignored with snapPoints.

props.name: modal
props.doc: false: no scrim, the page stays usable, focus is not trapped. Default true.

props.name: dragToClose
props.doc: Drag the panel toward its edge to close it. Default true (needs `dismissable`).

props.name: snapPoints
props.doc: Resting sizes: fractions of the viewport (0.4) or pixels (320). The largest sets the panel size.

props.name: snap
props.doc: Index into snapPoints (controlled). Default 0: it opens at the first listed point.

props.name: dismissable
props.doc: false: Escape, the overlay and × do not close it.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name when there is no title.

hadi-march/ui#Drawer.tr: `<Drawer open={$open} onClose={() => $open = false} side="bottom" snapPoints={[0.4, 0.9]} title="…">…</Drawer>` Kapanırken panel belgeden ayrılmadan önce animasyonla çıkar.

hadi-march/ui#Dropdown.name: Dropdown
hadi-march/ui#Dropdown.doc: Trigger with arbitrary floating content: `<Dropdown label="Filters">{(close) => …}</Dropdown>`

props.name: label
props.doc: Trigger text and accessible name.

props.name: icon
props.doc: Icon-only trigger.

props.name: trigger
props.doc: Custom trigger content.

hadi-march/ui#EASING_PRESETS.name: EASING_PRESETS
hadi-march/ui#EASING_PRESETS.doc: The engine's named cubic-bezier curves (registered in motion/engine/ease.ts).
hadi-march/ui#EASING_PRESETS.tr: Motorun adlandırılmış cubic-bezier eğrileri (motion/engine/ease.ts içinde kayıtlı).

props.name: name
props.doc: Register the curve in the motion engine under this name (defineEasing) on every change.

props.name: presets
props.doc: Presets (default: the engine's named curves).

props.name: duration
props.doc: Preview duration in ms (default 900).

props.name: preview
props.doc: Live preview: "move" (default), "scale", "fade" or "none".

props.name: compact
props.doc: A small curve, presets in one scrolling row, no CSS line: for an inspector (KeyframeTimeline uses it).

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#EditForm.name: EditForm
hadi-march/ui#EditForm.doc: Load → edit → save. Props: schema, load() → Promise<values>, save(values, { reason, changed }) → Promise<any>, reason (min length number or { min, title, message, purposes, danger }), title, description, sections, layout, cols, submitLabel, successMessage, onSaved(result, values), readonly, extra(form) → node, useResult, validateOn, ask (reason prompt, default askReason), notify (default toast).

props.name: reason
props.doc: Ask for a reason before saving: a minimum length or prompt settings.

props.name: successMessage
props.doc: false = no toast.

props.name: extra
props.doc: Extra buttons in the action bar.

props.name: useResult
props.doc: Reset the form from save()'s result instead of reloading.

props.name: ask
props.type: ((o: ReasonPrompt) => Promise<ReasonValue | null | undefined> | ReasonValue | null | undefined) | undefined
props.doc: Reason prompt (default askReason).

props.name: notify
props.doc: Success notice (default toast).

hadi-march/ui#EditForm.tr: Yükle → düzenle → kaydet. Prop'lar: schema, load() → Promise<values>, save(values, { reason, changed }) → Promise<any>, reason (en az uzunluk sayısı ya da { min, title, message, purposes, danger }), title, description, sections ve diğerleri.

hadi-march/ui#EmailInput.name: EmailInput
hadi-march/ui#EmailInput.doc: Text input for an e-mail address (email keyboard, trimmed, lower-cased).

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

props.name: autofocus
props.doc: Focus this field when it appears.

hadi-march/ui#EmailInput.tr: E-posta adresi için metin girdisi (e-posta klavyesi, kırpılır, küçük harfe çevrilir).

hadi-march/ui#EMOJI_SET.name: EMOJI_SET
hadi-march/ui#EMOJI_SET.doc: Default emoji grid of the panel (ChatComposer emoji button).
hadi-march/ui#EMOJI_SET.tr: Panelin varsayılan emoji ızgarası (ChatComposer emoji düğmesi).

hadi-march/ui#Empty.name: Empty
hadi-march/ui#Empty.doc: `<Empty icon="📭" title="No users yet" action={…}>Invite someone to get started.</Empty>`
hadi-march/ui#Empty.tr: `<Empty icon="📭" title="No users yet" action={…}>Invite someone to get started.</Empty>` — boş durum bileşeni.

hadi-march/ui#ErrorBox.name: ErrorBox
hadi-march/ui#ErrorBox.doc: `<ErrorBox error={err} retry={() => refetch()} title="Could not load" />`
hadi-march/ui#ErrorBox.tr: `<ErrorBox error={err} retry={() => refetch()} title="Could not load" />` — hata kutusu.

hadi-march/ui#Feed.name: Feed
hadi-march/ui#Feed.doc: `<Feed posts={$posts} hasMore={$more} onRefresh={reload} onLoadMore={next} onLike={like} onOpenMedia={open} />`

props.name: loading
props.doc: First page is loading: skeleton cards.

props.name: hasMore
props.doc: More pages exist (infinite scroll).

props.name: onRefresh
props.doc: Pull to refresh (and the keyboard Refresh button).

props.name: onLoadMore
props.doc: Next page; skeleton cards show at the end until it settles.

props.name: newCount
props.doc: New posts waiting above: shows the "N new posts" pill.

props.name: onShowNew
props.doc: The pill was pressed (merge the new posts); the feed scrolls to the top.

props.name: variant
props.doc: card: framed posts with space · flat: edge to edge with dividers. Default card.

props.name: empty
props.doc: Shown when there are no posts and nothing loads.

props.name: menu
props.doc: ⋯ menu items (args: [post]).

props.name: onLike
props.doc: Called with the next like state; update the post (optimistic).

props.name: onOpenMedia
props.type: ((index: number, el: HTMLElement, post: Post) => void) | undefined

props.name: clamp
props.doc: Lines before "more". Default 3; 0 never folds.

hadi-march/ui#Feed.tr: `<Feed posts={$posts} hasMore={$more} onRefresh={reload} onLoadMore={next} onLike={like} onOpenMedia={open} />` — gönderi akışı.

hadi-march/ui#Field.name: Field
hadi-march/ui#Field.doc: Label + control + help + error. With `name` inside a form (or `form` prop) it renders the schema field's input; otherwise wraps its children. Props: name, form, label, help, error, required, inline, compact, class, controlProps.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token (see ColorToken): "brand-blue", "success", "cat-3"… Default: the theme's primary.

props.name: name
props.doc: A schema field of the enclosing (or `form`) form; its control is rendered. Without it, the children are wrapped.

props.name: group
props.doc: Label as a group label (div) instead of <label for>.

props.name: controlProps
props.doc: Extra props for the rendered control.

hadi-march/ui#Field.tr: Etiket + denetim + yardım + hata. Bir formun içinde `name` ile (ya da `form` prop'uyla) şema alanının girdisini çizer; aksi halde alt öğelerini sarar. Prop'lar: name, form, label, help, error, required, inline, compact, class ve diğerleri.

hadi-march/ui#FieldContext.name: FieldContext
hadi-march/ui#FieldContext.doc: Context set by <Field>: { id, describedby(), invalid() } — controls pick their id / aria attributes from it.
hadi-march/ui#FieldContext.signature: const FieldContext: { id: symbol; defaultValue: FieldCtx | null }
hadi-march/ui#FieldContext.tr: <Field> tarafından ayarlanan bağlam: { id, describedby(), invalid() } — denetimler id ve aria özniteliklerini buradan alır.

hadi-march/ui#FileUpload.name: FileUpload
hadi-march/ui#FileUpload.doc: Props: accept, multiple, maxSize (bytes), maxFiles, upload(file, { onProgress(fraction|{loaded,total}), signal }) → Promise<result>, label (drop zone text). Value: without `upload` the File (or File[] with multiple); with `upload` the result(s). onError(message, file) is called for rejected files.

props.name: accept
props.doc: "image/*,.pdf"

props.name: maxSize
props.doc: Bytes.

props.name: label
props.doc: Drop zone text.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#FileUpload.tr: Prop'lar: accept, multiple, maxSize (bayt), maxFiles, upload(file, { onProgress(fraction|{loaded,total}), signal }) → Promise<result>, label (bırakma alanı metni). Değer: `upload` yoksa File (multiple ile File[]); varsa yükleme sonucu.

hadi-march/ui#firstDayOf.name: firstDayOf
hadi-march/ui#firstDayOf.doc: First day of week for a locale (0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday); Monday when Intl has no week info.
hadi-march/ui#firstDayOf.tr: Bir dil için haftanın ilk günü (0 = Pazar … 6 = Cumartesi); Intl hafta bilgisi vermiyorsa Pazartesi.

hadi-march/ui#FollowButton.name: FollowButton

props.name: onChange
props.doc: Called with the next state (follow → following, or requested when `private`; back to follow).

props.name: private
props.doc: A private account: following asks first.

props.name: name
props.doc: Whom (accessible name: "Follow Acme").

props.name: block
props.doc: Stretch to the container.

hadi-march/ui#FollowButton.tr: `<FollowButton state={$state} name={user.name} onChange={(s) => $state = s} />` — takip düğmesi.

hadi-march/ui#Form.name: Form
hadi-march/ui#Form.doc: Form. Auto-renders every active schema field, or your children (reach the controller with useFormContext()). Props: schema, initial, onSubmit, validateOn, form (an existing useForm), submitLabel, cancel (true = reset, or fn), cancelLabel, layout ("stack" | "grid"), cols, sections [{ title, description, fields }], actions (false hides the bar), confirmLeave, requireDirty, readonly, onReady(form), class.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token (see ColorToken): "brand-blue", "success", "cat-3"… Default: the theme's primary.

props.name: form
props.doc: An existing useForm() controller.

props.name: cancel
props.doc: true = reset, or a function.

props.name: actions
props.doc: false hides the submit bar.

hadi-march/ui#Form.tr: Form. Etkin her şema alanını ya da alt öğelerinizi otomatik çizer (denetleyiciye useFormContext() ile erişin). Prop'lar: schema, initial, onSubmit, validateOn, form (mevcut bir useForm), submitLabel, cancel ve diğerleri.

hadi-march/ui#FormActions.name: FormActions
hadi-march/ui#FormActions.doc: Submit / cancel bar with the submit error.

props.name: cancel
props.doc: true = reset, or a function.

props.name: requireDirty
props.doc: Disable submit until something changed.

props.name: extra
props.doc: Extra buttons before cancel / submit.

hadi-march/ui#FormActions.tr: Gönderim hatasını da gösteren gönder / vazgeç çubuğu.

hadi-march/ui#format.name: format
hadi-march/ui#format.doc: RGBA → "#rrggbb" or "#rrggbbaa", "rgb(r g b / a)" or "hsl(h s% l% / a)".
hadi-march/ui#format.signature: function format(c: Rgba, f: ColorFormat = "hex", hue?: number): string
hadi-march/ui#format.tr: RGBA → "#rrggbb" veya "#rrggbbaa", "rgb(r g b / a)" ya da "hsl(h s% l% / a)".

hadi-march/ui#formatCount.name: formatCount
hadi-march/ui#formatCount.doc: The text a count shows: `formatCount(1234)` → "1,2 B" (tr) / "1.2K" (en).

hadi-march/ui#formatDate.name: formatDate
hadi-march/ui#formatDate.doc: Format an ISO date for typing (numeric, locale order).
hadi-march/ui#formatDate.signature: function formatDate(iso: unknown, loc?: string): string
hadi-march/ui#formatDate.tr: ISO tarihini yazım için biçimlendirir (sayısal, dilin sırasıyla).

hadi-march/ui#formatNumber.name: formatNumber
hadi-march/ui#formatNumber.doc: Format a number for an input (no grouping by default so it stays easy to edit).
hadi-march/ui#formatNumber.signature: function formatNumber(n: number | null | undefined, loc?: string, __2: FormatNumberOptions = {}): string
hadi-march/ui#formatNumber.tr: Bir sayıyı girdi için biçimlendirir (düzenlemesi kolay kalsın diye varsayılan olarak gruplama yok).

hadi-march/ui#FormContext.name: FormContext
hadi-march/ui#FormContext.doc: The enclosing form (provided by useForm's <Form>, a wizard step…).
hadi-march/ui#FormContext.signature: const FormContext: { id: symbol; defaultValue: FormController | null }
hadi-march/ui#FormContext.tr: Çevreleyen form (useForm'un <Form>'u, bir sihirbaz adımı vb. sağlar).

hadi-march/ui#frame.name: frame
hadi-march/ui#frame.doc: Build a modal frame (overlay + panel). Must run inside an owner; the frame unregisters and restores focus on cleanup.
hadi-march/ui#frame.tr: Kipli bir çerçeve kurar (örtü + panel). Bir sahip içinde çalışmalı; temizlikte çerçeve kaydını siler ve odağı geri verir.

hadi-march/ui#frameSize.name: frameSize
hadi-march/ui#frameSize.doc: The frame (fw × fh px) in a view of vw × vh px for a state: aspect-fitted, centered.
hadi-march/ui#frameSize.signature: function frameSize(st: CropState, vw: number, vh: number): [number, number]
hadi-march/ui#frameSize.tr: Bir durum için vw × vh px görünümdeki çerçeve (fw × fh px): en-boy oranına sığdırılmış, ortalanmış.

hadi-march/ui#freeKey.name: freeKey
hadi-march/ui#freeKey.doc: A key not used in `obj`: base, base2, base3 …
hadi-march/ui#freeKey.signature: function freeKey(obj: Record<string, unknown>, base: string = "key"): string
hadi-march/ui#freeKey.tr: `obj` içinde henüz kullanılmayan bir anahtar üretir: base, base2, base3 sırasıyla.

hadi-march/ui#getAt.name: getAt
hadi-march/ui#getAt.doc: Value at a path (array of keys / indexes) inside a JSON value, or undefined.
hadi-march/ui#getAt.signature: function getAt(root: unknown, p: JsonPath): unknown
hadi-march/ui#getAt.tr: Bir JSON değeri içindeki yoldaki (anahtar / indeks dizisi) değer, yoksa undefined.

hadi-march/ui#gradientCss.name: gradientCss
hadi-march/ui#gradientCss.doc: CSS of a gradient (stops sorted by position).
hadi-march/ui#gradientCss.tr: Bir gradyanın CSS'i (duraklar konuma göre sıralanır).
